title: The Life I'm Building Doesn't Fit a Simple Timeline
seoTitle: The Life I'm Building | Faraz Ansari
description: A personal essay on life between India and Britain, family expectations, work, faith and the challenge of defining what it means to feel settled.
deck: On living between India and Britain, family expectations, unfinished ambitions, and learning to make peace with a life that is still taking shape.
